Cement Material Test Certificate (MTC) Receipt Verification 22 checkpoints across 7 sections.At every cement consignment receipt before stocking and release for use Download ExcelDownload PDF **22** Checkpoints **7** Sections Per consignment / per batch QC Engineer, Store In-charge [IS 269:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-269-2015) [IS 12269:2013](https://infralens.in/code/IS-12269-2013) [IS 8112:2013](https://infralens.in/code/IS-8112-2013) [IS 1489:2015](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1489-Part-1-2015) [IS 4031:1988](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4031-Part-3-1988) [IS 4032:1985](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4032-1985) Related [📐IS 269](https://infralens.in/code/IS-269) [✏️Curing Period Opc Ppc](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/curing-period-opc-ppc) [📘Cement Types & Grades](https://infralens.in/handbook/cement-types) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. MTC IDENTIFICATION AND AUTHENTICITY | | A1 | Verify MTC bears manufacturer letterhead, unique certificate number, and authorized signature/seal
Acceptance: Letterhead present; certificate number unique; QA manager signature and company seal affixed | Cl. 14 — Marking and certification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Verify BIS licence number (CM/L) and ISI mark printed on MTC and bags
Acceptance: Valid CM/L number; ISI mark legible on bag; licence valid on date of dispatch | Cl. 14 — BIS marking | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Verify batch/lot number on MTC matches bag markings and delivery challan
Acceptance: Batch number matches across MTC, bag, challan, and gate pass; no tampering evident | Cl. 14 — Batch traceability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Verify date of manufacture on MTC; cement not older than 3 months at receipt
Acceptance: Manufacture date <90 days from receipt; if older, additional strength test mandatory | Cl. 4.2 — Storage/age limit | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. CHEMICAL COMPOSITION VERIFICATION | | B1 | Verify Lime Saturation Factor (LSF) reported on MTC within specification
Acceptance: LSF: 0.80–1.02 for OPC 43/53; reported value within range | Table 1 — Chemical requirements | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Verify Magnesia (MgO) content on MTC
Acceptance: MgO ≤ 6.0% by mass for OPC; reported value compliant | Table 1 — MgO limit | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Verify Sulphuric anhydride (SO3) content on MTC
Acceptance: SO3 ≤ 3.0% (OPC); ≤ 3.5% (PPC); within limit | Table 1 — SO3 limit | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Verify Insoluble Residue and Loss on Ignition values on MTC
Acceptance: IR ≤ 5.0% (OPC), LOI ≤ 5.0%; PPC IR higher due to fly ash — refer IS 1489 | Table 1 — IR & LOI | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Verify Chloride content on MTC (especially for RCC with prestressing)
Acceptance: Cl⁻ ≤ 0.05% for cement; total in concrete ≤ 0.4 kg/m³ (RCC) or 0.1% (prestressed) | Cl. 5.3 — Chloride limit | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. PHYSICAL / MECHANICAL PROPERTIES VERIFICATION | | C1 | Verify fineness (specific surface by Blaine's method) on MTC
Acceptance: Blaine fineness ≥ 225 m²/kg (OPC); ≥ 300 m²/kg (PPC); reported value above minimum | Table 2 — Fineness | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Verify setting times (initial and final) reported on MTC
Acceptance: Initial ≥ 30 min; Final ≤ 600 min (OPC/PPC); within range | Table 2 — Setting times | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Verify soundness (Le Chatelier expansion / Autoclave) on MTC
Acceptance: Le Chatelier ≤ 10 mm; Autoclave expansion ≤ 0.8%; both within limits | Table 2 — Soundness | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Verify compressive strength at 3, 7, and 28 days reported on MTC
Acceptance: OPC 53: 3-d ≥ 27, 7-d ≥ 37, 28-d ≥ 53 MPa; OPC 43: 3-d ≥ 23, 7-d ≥ 33, 28-d ≥ 43 MPa | Table 2 — Compressive strength | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | For PPC — verify fly ash content (15-35%) and drying shrinkage on MTC
Acceptance: Fly ash 15-35% by mass; drying shrinkage ≤ 0.15%; compressive strength 28-d ≥ 33 MPa | Cl. 4 — PPC composition | OK
NC
NA
